snippet.title: Teddy Knight // Teaser
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325200/Teddy_Knight/

Step into the paws of an unlikely hero and journey through the toy chest! In Teddy Knight, a physics-based action roguelite, you play as Teddy, a brave stuffed knight on a mission to save the toy world from evil. Engage in fast-paced combat with unique “bounce” mechanics in a dark toy universe.

Developed by
Singular Division
